nodes.label: main()
nodes.desc: The single entrypoint invoked by the pip console script; parses argv and dispatches into the command table.

nodes.label: create_main_parser()
nodes.desc: Builds the top-level argparse parser that recognizes the subcommand plus its global options.

nodes.label: Command
nodes.desc: Base class for every subcommand; run() executes the body while _main() translates exceptions into exit codes.

nodes.label: RequirementCommand
nodes.desc: Shared base for install/download/wheel/lock; wires session, finder, preparer and builder into one command.

nodes.label: parse_requirements()
nodes.desc: Parses requirements.txt line by line: options, comments, line continuations and nested -r files.

nodes.label: InstallRequirement
nodes.desc: The central object for one requirement: specifiers, hashes, markers, plus its build/install state.

nodes.label: RequirementSet
nodes.desc: Collects all resolved requirements and drives their preparation before handing off to install.

nodes.label: PackageFinder
nodes.desc: Turns index pages into ranked installation candidates using CandidateEvaluator compatibility scoring.

nodes.label: LinkCollector
nodes.desc: Fetches and parses simple-index HTML pages into Link objects, caching pages per session.

nodes.label: PipSession
nodes.desc: The requests.Session subclass all HTTP traffic flows through, with cache-control, auth and retries.

nodes.label: wheel_builder.build()
nodes.desc: Builds wheels for sdists in isolated environments and decides which artifacts are worth caching.

nodes.label: WheelCache
nodes.desc: On-disk wheel cache keyed by origin, so rebuilt sdists are served from disk the next time.
